2609.27036.title: An open benchmark for machine learning-based polymer property prediction
2609.27036.paper_summary: Polymer property prediction lacks open, standardized benchmarks that enable rigorous comparison of machine-learning methods, with existing resources covering only a narrow fraction of polymer architectures, such as homopolymers. We introduce Polymer Benchmark 2026 (PolyBench26), an open dataset comprising nearly 250,000 polymer-property datapoints across eight physical properties, including data from experimental measurements, density functional theory, and molecular dynamics. The benchmark supports four evaluation tasks across homopolymers and alternating, random, and block copolymers: in-distribution property prediction, dataset-size scaling, repeat-unit complexity, and transfer to held-out polymer architectures. We compare language model, graph-based, and descriptor-based approaches and find graph-based models provide the lowest errors in property prediction, retain their advantage across the evaluated training-set sizes, and remain robust to increasing repeat-unit complexity. PolyBench26 provides a reproducible foundation for developing models for the increasingly complex polymer design space. The PolyBench26 benchmark is available open-source at https://github.com/rlearsch/PolymerBenchmark2026.
2609.27036.paper_summary_zh: 聚合物性質預測缺乏開放的、標準化的基準，這使得機器學習方法的嚴格比較變得困難，現有資源僅涵蓋了狹窄範圍的聚合物架構，例如均聚物。我們介紹了聚合物基準 2026 (PolyBench26)，這是一個開放數據集，包含近 250,000 個聚合物性質數據點，涵蓋八種物理性質，包括來自實驗測量、密度泛函理論和分子動力學的數據。該基準支持四個評估任務，涵蓋均聚物以及交替、隨機和區塊共聚物：分佈內性質預測、數據集大小擴展、重複單元複雜性以及轉移到保留的聚合物架構。我們比較了語言模型、基於圖的和基於描述符的方法，發現基於圖的模型在性質預測中提供了最低的誤差，並在評估的訓練集大小中保持其優勢，且對於增加的重複單元複雜性仍然穩健。PolyBench26 為開發日益複雜的聚合物設計空間的模型提供了可重複的基礎。PolyBench26 基準可在 https://github.com/rlearsch/PolymerBenchmark2026 開源獲得。
